meta.name: article-illustrator
meta.description: 内容创作者和自媒体创作者在撰写长文时，当需要“给文章配图”或“添加插图”时使用。自动分析文章结构，精准识别需要视觉辅助的位置，生成并插入契合语境的插画，将抽象概念具象化，一键完成高质量图文排版，大幅提升阅读体验。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为长文自动生成贴切插画，提升阅读体验
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果写长文时总为配图发愁
copy.tagline_en: Automatically generate fitting illustrations for articles to enhance reading.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often struggle to find images for your articles.

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 会自动分析文章结构,找出需要配图的位置,逐张生成 16:9 插画并保存到 imgs/ 目录,再用 Markdown 将图片插入文章对应段落,最后输出配图汇总。
howto.when: 当你说出“给文章配图”“为文章生成插图”“添加配图”等,或明确要求为文章生成图片时触发。

say.note: Claude 会分析文章并生成配图计划。

say.text: 为文章生成插图并插入对应位置。
say.note: 配图会保存到 imgs/ 目录并插入段落后面。

say.text: 这篇长文需要几张示意图,帮我加上。
say.note: 按流程生成、插入并输出汇总。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude analyzes the article structure, identifies spots that need visuals, generates 16:9 illustrations one by one, saves them to an imgs/ folder, inserts them into the article with Markdown, then outputs a summary.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you explicitly ask Claude to add images or illustrations to an article, e.g. "illustrate this article", "generate illustrations", "add images", etc.

say_en.note: Claude analyzes the article and creates an illustration plan.

say_en.text: Generate illustrations and insert them where needed.
say_en.note: Images are saved to imgs/ and inserted after relevant paragraphs.

say_en.text: Add a few diagrams to this long article.
say_en.note: It follows the workflow, inserts images, and outputs a summary.
